items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 Endgame was fixed! Back to 5 stars revie
items.summary: Endgame was fixed! Back to 5 stars review since the devs do take feedback from the community. Morimens is a difficulty and rewarding TCG game. Lovecraftian. Characters bring 5 cards for a 4 team comp. Play with Chaos "energy", Caro heal-rush, Ultra draw & extra turns or Aequor tentacle damage and defense. Mix it. Visual novel storytelling, collabs like Saya character and a very F2P friendly environment. You can even get some limited premium currency by converting your pull currency for free.
items.author: Murillo Carvalho
